title: comicfn2dict
description: The metadata dict that `comicfn2dict()` parses from a comic filename and `dict2comicfn()` writes a filename from. Every key is optional: `comicfn2dict()` leaves a key out rather than return it empty, and `dict2comicfn()` skips a key that is missing or empty.

series.description: The series name: the first run of free text. Underscores become spaces, dots between letters become spaces (`Z.O.O.` becomes `Z O O`), and a trailing credit of three or more words after `by` is dropped.

volume.description: The volume number, from `v1`, `Vol. 1`, `Volume 1`, `1 (of 3)` or `Book One`, which becomes `1`. When a filename holds two parenthesized years, the first is the volume.

volume_count.description: The number of volumes, from `(of N)` after the volume.

issue.description: The issue number as written, with any leading zeros and suffix: `001`, `1.1`, `½`, `27AU`, `54.LR`. It is read from `#N`, `N (of M)`, the word `issue`, or a number that starts or ends a run of text. A `#` before letters gives a letter issue such as `Omega`. With no issue but a volume, the volume is copied here.

issue_count.description: The number of issues, from `(of N)` after the issue.

year.description: The year, from a parenthesized year such as `(2020)`, a date, or a year that ends a run of text.

month.description: The month number. A numeric month is kept as written. A month name, full or abbreviated, becomes its two-digit number: `Dec` becomes `12`. Of a range such as `Jan-Feb`, only the first month is kept.

day.description: The day of the month as written, from a date such as `2020-12-31` or `Dec 31, 2020`.

title.description: The issue title: free text after the series and an issue, volume, year or month, and before the original format and scan info. It is also read from the text after a lone spaced dash, as in `Series - Title`, from a single Title Case parenthesized group, or from `Book N`.

publisher.description: A publisher that comicfn2dict knows by name, as written in the filename: `DC`, `Marvel`, `Image`.

original_format.description: A publication format that comicfn2dict knows by name, as written in the filename: `TPB`, `Digital`, `HC`.

scan_info.description: The scanner or release group: the parenthesized group after the original format, as in `(Digital) (Empire)`, or the text after a `-` or `:` inside the format's group, as in `(Digital-Empire)`. A bare `c2c` fills it when nothing else does.

remainders.description: Text that fits no other key, as a tuple of strings. Leftover parenthesized and bracketed groups are kept together as one string in parentheses: `[5 covers]` becomes `(5 covers)`.

ext.description: The file extension, without its dot: `cbz`, `cbr`, `pdf`. `dict2comicfn()` writes `cbz` when the key is missing.

date.description: Read by `dict2comicfn()` only; `comicfn2dict()` never returns it. Text written as the date in place of the one built from year, month and day.
